To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel 6-Do-F tracking approach that operates on egocentric images from a handheld controller, and achieves state of the art performance on a novel dataset of 540,000 images.

we collected the HMD controller dataset, that consists of over 540000 image pairs labeled with the full 3D pose of a handheld controller and we propose an SSD-AF-Stere3D model that achieves a mean average 3D error of 33 mm in 3D pose prediction.
We present the first dataset for 6-Dof egocentric tracking of a handheld object and show that a stereo-based approach outperforms monocular approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of 6-Dof tracking and 6-DoFs pose estimation of handheld controllers from a single RGB camera.
efficient 6- DoF tracking of handheld controllers from egocentric perspectives and we hope our dataset and models will be useful to other research groups.
the problem of efficient and accurate 6-DoFs tracking of handheld controllers from egocentric perspectives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have presented the first real time, 6 DoF tracking solution for handheld controllers in egocentric views.
the SSD-AF-Stere3D model performs the best for 3D key point prediction and the 6D-SLAM model performs the best in full 6-DOF tracking.
the proposed approach enables 6-Dof tracking of small handheld controllers from egocentric views.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a new dataset for egocentric 6DoF pose tracking of a handheld object.
we have demonstrated a real-time egocentric 3D tracking solution for a handheld device.
we present a dataset for the task of 6-Dof tracking of handheld objects from egocentric stereo views.
The main takeaway from our work is that
egocentric 3D tracking of small handheld objects is feasible and can be done in real time on mobile devices.
egocentric 6DoF tracking of handheld controllers is a feasible and practical problem to solve.

it is possible to achieve accurate 6-Dof pose estimation of handheld controllers in egocentric camera images using only a single RGB camera and IMU on the controller, without requiring any additional external sensors.
